title: hello.ok
description: server → host and clients. Accepts the handshake and states the limits of this connection. After it the client must send room.create (host), room.join (phone) or room.resume (either) within 30 s.

protocolVersion.description: Server protocol version (equals the client version).

serverTimeMs.description: Server clock when the message was sent.

heartbeatMs.description: Interval at which the client must send `clock.ping`. Always 5000.

idleTimeoutMs.description: The server drops the connection after this long without any frame. Always 15000.

maxFrameBytes.description: Largest frame the client may send, UTF-8 bytes. PHONE: 2048. HOST: 65536.

maxMsgsPerSec.description: Overall message budget of the connection. PHONE: 60. HOST: 400.

maxBytesPerSec.description: Overall inbound byte budget of the connection. PHONE: 8192. HOST: 262144.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
